title: Outstanding Technical Features of Traction System in N700S Shinkansen New Generation Standardized High Speed Train
version: 2021 IEEJ Journal of Industry Applications 10(4), pp. 402–410, DOI 10.1541/ieejjia.20012560
lineage: Original publisher's text inspected. Saved notes paraphrase the identified passages.

passages.note: The JR Central authors date the Series N700's train-draft cooling of the converter to 2007. They say that the N700S built on that accumulated technology by combining the cooling architecture with silicon carbide devices and six-pole motors.
Smaller underfloor equipment gave the N700S designers more flexibility for different train lengths and freed space for battery-powered self-movement during a loss of power.
